verdict.rationale: dlt's SQL database source relies on SQLAlchemy/PyArrow/pandas/ConnectorX query-based extraction with cursor-field incremental loading and merge/upsert logic (dlt-docs-24, dlt-docs-38, dlt-docs-18), not log-based CDC reading binlog/WAL streams. No evidence pack item mentions binlog, WAL, Debezium, or log-based change capture, so there is no support for capturing updates/deletes without polling the source.
